motion.name: working-light
motion.purpose: Rack shop field to folio mechanical.

components.name: RECORD
components.description: Creates a job on the current deck.
components.css: .ds-record { padding: 4px 10px; border: 1px solid var(--color-live); background: var(--color-live); color: var(--color-live-ink); font-family: var(--font-plaque); font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.16em; border-radius: 0; cursor: pointer; } .ds-record:hover { background: var(--color-ink); border-color: var(--color-ink); color: var(--color-ground); } .ds-record:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid var(--color-live); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Job slab
components.description: Waxed art on the mechanical. HIT enters the folio.
components.css: .ds-slab { background: var(--color-card); border: 1px solid var(--color-ink); border-radius: 0; padding: 10px 12px 9px; } .ds-slab h2 { margin: 0; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-slab:hover { background: var(--color-card-2); }

components.name: Directory select
components.description: Process-red block behind the live stem name.
components.css: .ds-dir-on { padding: 1px 6px; border: 0; border-radius: 0; background: var(--color-live); color: var(--color-live-ink); font-size: 13px; line-height: 18px; } .ds-dir-on:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid var(--color-live); outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview: The studio is one prepress board. Jobs are waxed art. Nested work is strips. The catalogue is unused copy in a stem galley.
keyCharacteristics: Two languages: boxed nest vs TUI stems

rules.name: Two languages
rules.body: PM never draws stems. Directory never draws boxed jobs.

dos: Do enter the job. Do keep FIND as search.
donts: Don't revive cassette housing, Oswald, or live orange.
